spec.record: D-card — First-run welcome card + auth-error family
spec.design_question: What must be true before the welcome card claims success and morphs into the live pill — a token merely STORED in the Keychain (instant, but it can still 401 seconds later and yank the user back to an error card) or a token GitHub has actually ANSWERED for (a few seconds slower, but the morph can never celebrate a state the system can't back)? Subordinate fork the same session should settle: may the non-key panel become key for one deliberate click into a secure field (variants 1/2/4), or must intake stay zero-focus paste-only (variant 3)?
spec.current_state: There is NO in-app token entry today — intake is the terminal (`security add-generic-password`, README.md:59-73; README.md:71-73 explicitly promises "a future release adds an in-app token entry screen"). At launch with no token, AppDelegate shows a MessageView: symbol "key.fill" + one dense paragraph ("No GitHub token found. Create a classic PAT… see the README.") linking to github.com/settings/tokens (AppDelegate.swift:113-116); a launch-detected non-classic shape routes to showAuthFailure(.wrongShape) (AppDelegate.swift:110-111). Auth failures are already reason-routed with distinct copy and symbols — .invalidToken/401 ("exclamationmark.triangle.fill"), .ssoOrScope/403 ("lock.shield.fill"), .wrongShape — all funneling into the same MessageView + settings/tokens URL (AppDelegate.swift:236-251; scheduler.onAuthFailure wired at 154-156). MessageView itself (IslandContentView.swift:351-392) is a 360pt-wide, ≥56pt-tall horizontal stack — icon fixed **systemOrange across all themes** (line 362, pre-color-doctrine) + a wrapping 12px label, insets 12/16, the WHOLE card clickable to open the URL; presented at width 360 / height max(56, fitting) (HUDPanelController.swift:279-284), and a message force-shows the panel immediately (HUDPanelController.swift:89-94). The plumbing the card needs is complete: submitToken(_:) does trim → looksLikeClassicPAT WALL (reject BEFORE any Keychain write) → KeychainPAT.store (add-or-update, kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlock, KeychainPAT.swift:62-87) → clearMessage + startLiveSession with NO relaunch (AppDelegate.swift:204-224; DEBUG env-gated driver proves the hot start, 126-132). looksLikeClassicPAT = "ghp_" prefix + ≥40 chars (KeychainPAT.swift:119-121); redacted() renders only "ghp_•(40)" (110-113) — the secret never reaches a log, error, or display. Load-bearing constraint for any field: HUDPanel.canBecomeKey == false (HUDPanel.swift:10-13, focus-non-theft) — today NOTHING in the island can receive keystrokes; every interactive view is gesture-driven under a non-key panel (IslandClickableView, HUDPanel.swift:58-109). Geometry/motion facts for the mocks: island corner radius 14 continuous + 0.5px hairline border, 1px under Increase Contrast (HUDPanelController.swift:32, IslandSurfaceFactory.swift:53-57, Theme.swift:76); collapsed pill height 36, radius 14, loading pill 52 wide (CollapsedPillView.swift:8,16,44-45); expanded island width 520, insets 18 sides/16 vertical, 8 stack spacing (IslandContentView.swift:9,108-120); menuBarGap 8, top-center (IslandGeometry.swift:21,29-33); content swaps are INSTANT — present() has no animation (HUDPanelController.swift:326-338); the only motion in the app is the 120ms ease-out hover fade, Reduce-Motion → instant (HUDPanel.swift:87-104). GitHub theme tokens: surface #0D1117, border #30363D, ink #E6EDF3/#7D8590/#484F58, accent #2F81F7, danger #F85149, success #3FB950, caution #D29922, hover white@6% (Theme.swift:111-119).

variants.name: The Concierge — titled steps card with in-island secure field
variants.essence: A calm 420px welcome card — title, one-line read-only promise, two numbered steps, a secure field with an inline Connect affordance — that cross-fades to a one-line confirmation and morphs into the loading pill the moment the Keychain store succeeds.
variants.spec: CARD: 420w × ~230h, radius 14 continuous, surface #0D1117, hairline 0.5px #30363D (1px opaque under Increase Contrast), shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45), top-center 8px under the menu bar. Padding 16 top / 18 sides / 14 bottom; vertical stack, 12px block gap. HEADER row (h20): key glyph 13px #7D8590 + 8px + 'Connect GitHub' 13px/600 #E6EDF3. PROMISE line: 11px #7D8590, ≤2 lines — placeholder '[githud reads your notifications — it never writes — D-copy]'. STEPS (2 rows, 10px gap): 16×16 number circle (1px border #30363D, transparent fill, 10px/600 tabular #7D8590) + 8px + step text 12px #E6EDF3; step 1 carries a trailing 'GitHub ↗' link, 11px #7D8590, underline on hover, opens https://github.com/settings/tokens (same URL every state uses today); step 2 = '[paste it below — Keychain line — D-copy]'. FIELD row h32, full width: well radius 8, bg #161B22, border 1px #30363D; 10px left pad, lock glyph 11px #484F58; input 12px ui-monospace #E6EDF3, caret #2F81F7, placeholder 'ghp_…' #484F58, secure-masked (●) after first char. Focus = border #2F81F7 AND width 1→1.5px over 120ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.58,1) — the width change survives gray-swap. Trailing-inside CONNECT: 'Connect ⏎' 12px/500; empty field → #484F58 inert; non-empty → #E6EDF3 with 6px-radius hover fill rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 120ms; when live shape gate passes (ghp_ + ≥40 chars) a 10px check glyph fades in (120ms) left of the label in #3FB950 — success color spent ONLY on 'submit just unlocked' (shape carries it on gray-swap). FOOTER caption 11px #484F58: '[read-only · stored in Keychain, never on disk — D-copy]'. ERROR SLOT between field and footer: reason glyph 11px + sentence 11px, both #F85149; glyph per reason — wrongShape=triangle-exclaim, 401=key-slash, 403=lock-shield (shape disambiguates on gray-swap); trailing 'GitHub settings ↗' underlined; appears as a 120ms ease-out opacity fade, NO translation; field border → 1px #F85149 while the error stands; first keystroke clears both. SUBMIT: Return or Connect → trim → shape gate (fail = wrongShape error, no other motion) → submitToken; on store success: card content fades out 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1), a centered confirmation row fades in 150ms — check glyph 13px in INK #E6EDF3 (matching the ink all-clear check in the pill; deliberately not green — the morph is the moment, not the hue) + '[Connected — watching GitHub — D-copy]' 12px #E6EDF3 — hold 900ms, then the island frame animates 420×230 → 52×36 (the loading-pill size, which claims nothing) over 320ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), radius constant at 14, loading-dot glyph #484F58 fading in over the final 120ms. prefers-reduced-motion: every fade/morph becomes an instant swap; the 900ms hold remains (static). AUTH-ERROR FAMILY = this same card: header title swaps per reason [D-copy], step-1 text swaps to 'create a FRESH token' for 401, the error slot is pre-filled, the field sits empty and ready — errors are the welcome card with one row lit, never a different species. KEYBOARD: the ONE sanctioned key moment — canBecomeKey returns true only while a field-bearing card is showing AND the user has clicked the field (a nonactivating panel takes keystrokes without activating the app, Spotlight-style); Esc or click-away resigns key instantly and focus returns to the foreground app.
variants.doctrine_fit: Ink-dominant; danger only on a changed next-move (the reason line = intervene); the lone green check marks a genuinely unlocked action; every motion maps 1:1 to a keystroke, click, or store-success; links visible without hover (no hover-as-primary); Open-on-GitHub is the only external action; gray-swap survives via per-reason glyph shapes + border-width focus cue.
variants.risks: The panel-key exception is a real focus-non-theft burden payment — it needs the screen-recording proof that the foreground app is never interrupted except by the user's own click into the field. The success moment fires on STORE success: a well-shaped but revoked token celebrates, then 401s seconds later (mitigated — the morph lands on the loading pill, which claims nothing — but the celebration still slightly outruns the truth). The green unlock-check may be judged an over-spend of success color; ink fallback is trivial.
variants.mock_notes: Island div: width 420px; background:#0D1117; border-radius:14px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.5px #30363D, 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); position it 8px below a fake 24px menu-bar strip on a desktop-gradient body (e.g. linear-gradient(160deg,#3a4a5f,#1a2230)). Font: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Text',sans-serif; token field: ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo, 12px. Field well: height 32px; background:#161B22; border:1px solid #30363D; border-radius:8px; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0,0,.58,1), border-width 120ms. Use a real <input type=password> with placeholder 'ghp_…'; JS shape gate = /^ghp_.{36,}/ on trimmed value toggles the Connect state + green check (fade via opacity transition 120ms). Success sequence in JS: card inner opacity→0 150ms → swap to confirmation row (opacity→1 150ms) → 900ms setTimeout → animate island width/height to 52×36 with transition: width 320ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), height 320ms same; keep border-radius 14px; fade in a 12px dot glyph last 120ms. Draw SF-like glyphs as inline 12–13px SVGs, 1.5px stroke: key (circle+shaft), lock, check, triangle-exclaim, key-with-diagonal-slash, shield-with-keyhole. Add a small mock-only control strip UNDER the desktop (outside the island) with buttons: [no token] [wrong shape] [401] [403] [submit success] to flip the family states so the reviewer can walk all of them. Honor @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) → transition:none.

variants.name: The Handshake Ledger — steps that are live receipts, verified before celebrated
variants.essence: The numbered steps ARE a live ledger of real system events — Token / Keychain / GitHub — each row checked only when its underlying call actually returned, errors landing on the exact row that failed, and the morph to the pill firing only after GitHub genuinely answered.
variants.spec: CARD: 420w × ~250h, same shell as welcome-steps-card (radius 14, #0D1117, 0.5px #30363D hairline, shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45), padding 16/18/14, 12px block gap). HEADER + PROMISE identical to welcome-steps-card. LEDGER: 3 rows h28, gap 8; each row = 16×16 state slot + 10px + label 12px/500 #E6EDF3 in a fixed 76px column + detail 11px #7D8590. Slot states: PENDING = empty circle, 1.5px border #30363D; DONE = 10px check glyph #E6EDF3 inside the circle, fading in 120ms ease-out ONLY when the real callback fires; FAILED = the per-reason glyph 12px #F85149 replacing the circle (120ms fade). Rows: (1) 'Token' — pending detail '[paste below — D-copy]' #484F58 → done detail = the REAL redacted form 'ghp_•(40)' ui-monospace 11px #7D8590 (KeychainPAT.redacted — the only form of the secret that ever renders); (2) 'Keychain' — '—' → 'stored'; (3) 'GitHub' — '—' → 'verifying…' (STATIC text, deliberately no spinner — no ambient motion; the words state the fact) → 'connected' | failed. EVENT BINDING (all real, all existing except one seam): rows 1+2 check when submitToken returns .success (store is synchronous; visually staggered 0ms/150ms — both events truly happened, in that order); row 3 flips to 'verifying…' when startLiveSession begins, checks on the first poll's rows callback, or FAILS on onAuthFailure — 401 fails row 3 with key-slash, 403 fails row 3 with lock-shield, wrongShape fails row 1 with triangle-exclaim and rows 2–3 stay pending (progress is never fabricated), a Keychain write error fails row 2. Remedy line under the failed row, indented 26px: 11px #F85149 sentence [D-copy] + 'GitHub settings ↗' underlined. FIELD row + FOOTER caption: identical spec to welcome-steps-card (32px well, #161B22, mono, focus = accent border + 1→1.5px width, same key-moment rule); the field stays visible until all rows check (retry needs it), and re-submitting resets rows 1–3 to pending instantly (no animation — a reset is not progress). SUCCESS: all 3 checked → hold 700ms → island morphs over 320ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) to whatever the collapsed pill currently measures (52×36 if data hasn't landed; the real gauge size if the first poll already delivered rows), radius constant 14, pill content fading in over the final 120ms. prefers-reduced-motion: all fades instant; holds remain. AUTH-ERROR FAMILY: structurally FREE — a runtime 401/403 re-presents this card with rows 1–2 pre-checked (a token exists in the Keychain — true) and row 3 failed + remedy; wrong-shape shows row 1 failed; there is no second card species at all.
variants.doctrine_fit: The strongest expression of the moat: like pulse-honesty, the card can never claim a state the system can't back — 'connected' requires GitHub's actual answer, exactly the contract that forbids null-rollup→green. Every check is motion mapped 1:1 to a real event; 'verifying…' is honest stillness, not a spinner; ink until a genuine intervene-moment; the family collapses into one structure (the failing row), which is the brief's 'same family' requirement made literal.
variants.risks: The card lingers 2–6s on 'verifying…' during the slow sequential first fetch — static text may read as hung, and the temptation to add a spinner (ambient motion) must be resisted; the pass/fail rows must stay bound to real callbacks forever or the whole surface becomes a trust lie. Needs ONE seam beyond 'visuals + one call into submitToken': a first-poll-outcome observer feeding the card (onAuthFailure exists; a first-success signal must be tapped from the rows callback). Three receipts for one paste may be judged ceremonious for a one-time flow. Shares the panel-key exception and its burden proof.
variants.mock_notes: Same island shell + palette + font stacks + control strip as welcome-steps-card (420px, #0D1117, radius 14, inset 0.5px #30363D hairline). Ledger row: display:grid; grid-template-columns:16px 76px 1fr; column-gap:10px; height:28px; align-items:center. Pending slot: 16px circle, border:1.5px solid #30363D. Check/fail glyphs = inline SVG (10px check stroke #E6EDF3; 12px triangle/key-slash/shield stroke #F85149), opacity transition 120ms ease-out. Simulate the real timeline in JS on submit: t0 row1 check + detail swaps to 'ghp_•(40)' (font ui-monospace 11px #7D8590), t+150ms row2 check, t+150ms row3 detail 'verifying…', then a 2200ms setTimeout → either row3 check + 'connected' → 700ms hold → morph (width/height transition 320ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1) to 52×36) — or, per the control strip's [401]/[403] toggle, row3 fail glyph + indented remedy line (margin-left:26px, color #F85149, link underlined). [wrong shape] fails row1 and leaves rows 2–3 pending. Deliberately render 'verifying…' with NO animation so the reviewer feels the honest-stillness tradeoff. prefers-reduced-motion → transition:none.

variants.name: The Zero-Focus Paste — no field, no keyboard, no key window, ever
variants.essence: Intake is one deliberate click — a 'Paste token' chip that reads the clipboard, shows only the redacted shape, and submits — so the panel never becomes key and focus-non-theft survives absolutely untouched.
variants.spec: CARD: 360w (today's MessageView width) × ~170h, same shell (radius 14, #0D1117, 0.5px #30363D, shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)), padding 16/18/14, 12px block gap. HEADER row: key glyph 13px #7D8590 + 'Connect GitHub' 13px/600 #E6EDF3. INSTRUCTION line 12px #7D8590, ≤2 lines: '[create a classic token, copy it, then click Paste — D-copy]'. ACTION row h32, 8px gap, two chips — each: radius 8, 1px border #30363D, padding 0 12px, 12px/500 #E6EDF3, hover fill rgba(255,255,255,0.06) over 120ms ease-out + pointing hand: CHIP A 'Create token ↗' → opens https://github.com/settings/tokens (reads nothing, writes nothing — the action ceiling). CHIP B 'Paste token' → on click (and ONLY on click) reads NSPasteboard.general, trims, runs looksLikeClassicPAT: PASS → chip content cross-fades 120ms to the redacted 'ghp_•(40)' ui-monospace 11px #7D8590 + 10px check glyph #E6EDF3 (the secret itself NEVER renders), holds 600ms, calls submitToken, then the island morphs 320ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) to the 52×36 loading pill, radius constant 14, dot glyph fading in the final 120ms. FAIL → an error line fades in (120ms, opacity only) under the action row: per-reason glyph 11px + sentence 11px, both #F85149 — triangle-exclaim = wrong shape, key-slash = 401, lock-shield = 403, plus a fourth clipboard-empty state with its own glyph (dashed circle) and copy [D-copy]; the chip is untouched and immediately retryable. FOOTER caption 11px #484F58, two lines: '[read-only · Keychain — D-copy]' and the disclosure '[the clipboard is read only when you click Paste — D-copy]'. AUTH-ERROR FAMILY: the same card with header title per reason [D-copy] and the error line pre-filled; both chips persist, making the retry loop explicit (Create → copy → Paste). ARCHITECTURE: zero panel changes — HUDPanel.canBecomeKey stays false; every control is an IslandClickableView-style gesture target; there is no first responder anywhere. prefers-reduced-motion: all fades/morphs instant; the 600ms redacted-confirmation hold remains (static).
variants.doctrine_fit: The purest survival of focus-non-theft — the existing non-key panel architecture is untouched, so the burden needs no new proof; the clipboard read maps 1:1 to a deliberate click (attention-non-theft clean); the secret never renders (redacted only — stronger than a masked field, which at least holds the value in a focusable control); Open-on-GitHub remains the ceiling; ink except the intervene-line.
variants.risks: Hard dependency on the token being on the clipboard — a user who typed it somewhere or copied something since hits a dead end only copy can explain. macOS Sequoia-era pasteboard privacy can interpose a system alert on first programmatic read — a jarring OS prompt on the app's highest-leverage trust surface unless the disclosure line pre-empts it. Breaks the secure-field convention users expect from credential UIs (some will read 'reads your clipboard' as MORE invasive, not less). githud also can't clear the clipboard afterward without acting on the user's behalf — the token lingers there.
variants.mock_notes: Island div 360px wide, same shell/palette/font stacks/desktop backdrop/control strip as the other variants. Chips: display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #30363D; border-radius:8px; color:#E6EDF3; font:500 12px -apple-system; transition:background 120ms cubic-bezier(0,0,.58,1); hover background rgba(255,255,255,.06); cursor:pointer. Mock the clipboard: the control strip sets a fake-clipboard variable ([valid ghp_ token] / [fine-grained github_pat_] / [empty]); clicking 'Paste token' branches on it. Pass path: swap chip innerHTML to '<svg check> ghp_•(40)' (ui-monospace 11px #7D8590, check stroke #E6EDF3), 600ms setTimeout, then island transition width/height → 52×36 over 320ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1). Fail path: insert the error line (opacity 0→1 120ms), color #F85149, per-reason inline SVG (triangle / key-slash / shield / dashed circle). Also mock the OS pasteboard alert as a small centered system-style dialog (rgba backdrop, #ECECEC light panel, SF text) triggered once on first Paste click, so the reviewer FEELS that risk. prefers-reduced-motion → transition:none.

variants.name: The Pill-Native Setup — no card, setup as just another pill state
variants.essence: First-run is a 96px 'Set up' pill that expands on click into a single-row island holding only the secure field and one caption line — welcome by subtraction, with the morph to the loading pill as the entire success moment.
variants.spec: COLLAPSED SETUP PILL: height 36, radius 14, width 96, same shell colors; content centered: key glyph 12px #7D8590 + 6px + 'Set up' 12px/500 #E6EDF3; hover fill rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 120ms + pointing hand; click → expand. EXPANDED ROW: 360×64, radius 14, padding 12 vertical / 14 sides; line 1: the field well (same spec as welcome-steps-card: h32, radius 8, bg #161B22, border 1px #30363D, key glyph 12px #484F58 leading inside, input 12px ui-monospace #E6EDF3 secure-masked, placeholder 'ghp_…' #484F58, focus = #2F81F7 + 1→1.5px width over 120ms) + 8px + trailing 'token ↗' link 11px #7D8590 underline-on-hover → https://github.com/settings/tokens; line 2 (6px below): caption 11px #484F58 one line '[classic · notifications scope · Keychain — D-copy]'. EXPAND animation: width 96→360, height 36→64 over 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1) — mapped to the click. SUBMIT on ⏎: shape gate FAIL → caption swaps to the reason sentence 11px #F85149 with leading per-reason glyph (triangle/key-slash/shield) and the field border → 1px #F85149, both 120ms fades; typing reverts both. PASS → submitToken; on store success the row morphs directly to the 52×36 loading pill over 280ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), field content fading out over the first 120ms — NO interstitial confirmation; the morph IS the success moment. AUTH-ERROR FAMILY, collapsed: the pill shows the per-reason glyph 12px in #F85149 + 'Token' 12px/500 #E6EDF3 (width ~86; the glyph SHAPE differs per reason, so gray-swap holds); click → expands to the row with the danger caption pre-filled; the 403 SSO remedy needs TWO caption lines, growing the row to 360×78 [copy budget is the D-copy boundary's hardest case here]. KEYBOARD: same single sanctioned key-moment rule as welcome-steps-card (key only while the field-bearing state shows AND the user clicked the field; Esc/click-away resigns). prefers-reduced-motion: expand + morph become instant swaps.
variants.doctrine_fit: Setup speaks the product's own pill vocabulary — no new chrome class, the calmest and smallest possible first-run footprint; every motion is click- or submit-mapped; ink-dominant with danger only on intervene; the trailing link is visible without hover.
variants.risks: Deliberately under-serves the trust job the PLAN calls the single highest-leverage surface: no promise line, no read-only reassurance visible before the user commits — one caption line carries everything. The 403 two-clause remedy barely fits; any overflow pushes remedy copy toward tooltips, which would violate no-hover-as-primary. A bare 'Set up' pill may not explain itself to a first-run user. Shares the panel-key exception and its focus-non-theft proof.
variants.mock_notes: Two-state island div, same shell/palette/fonts/backdrop/control strip as the others. Collapsed: width 96px; height 36px; border-radius 14px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap 6px. Expanded: width 360px; height 64px (78px for the 403 state). Transition: width 180ms cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1), height 180ms same, on click. Field well identical CSS to welcome-steps-card; error state adds border-color #F85149 (transition 120ms) + swaps the caption div to color #F85149 with a leading 11px SVG glyph. Success: on Enter with /^ghp_.{36,}/, fade input opacity→0 over 120ms, then transition island to width 52px/height 36px over 280ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1) and fade in the loading-dot glyph (#484F58). Control strip buttons: [first-run] [wrong shape] [401] [403] [success], with 401/403 also demonstrating the collapsed danger-glyph pill (glyph stroke #F85149 next to 'Token' in #E6EDF3). prefers-reduced-motion → transition:none.

recommendation.why: It is the only variant whose success moment cannot outrun the truth: the morph fires only after GitHub actually answered, so a well-shaped-but-revoked token never gets a celebration the app must retract seconds later — the same never-fabricate contract pulse-honesty already enforces, now on the app's single highest-leverage trust surface. It also gives the entire auth-error family one structural home (the ledger row that failed) instead of sibling cards, which is the brief's 'same family' requirement made literal, and errors arrive pre-contextualized (rows 1–2 stay honestly checked on a runtime 401). The costs are small and known: one first-poll-outcome observer beyond the landed plumbing, and a few seconds of honest static 'verifying…' that the mock lets the human feel before ratifying.

review.record: D-card — First-run welcome card + auth-error family

verdicts.reason: Two doctrine hits, both fixable. (1) FABRICATED STATE: the confirmation row ('Connected — watching GitHub' + check) fires on Keychain STORE success — a GitHub-backed claim the system cannot back at that instant; a well-shaped revoked token gets a celebration the app retracts on the 401 seconds later. This is the null→green class pulse-honesty forbids, and D-copy brackets can't fix it because the violation is the timing of the claim, not the wording. (2) COLOR MISUSE: the green check is justified as success=action-unlocked, but per the variant's own spec Connect is already active at any non-empty field — so green marks a validity PREDICTION, not an unlock ('color says what changes the next move' fails). Everything else survived the hunt: all motion is keystroke/click/store-mapped, per-reason glyph shapes + border-width focus cue survive gray-swap, links visible without hover, the key-moment is inside the scoped keyboard-session proposal with the burden proof named, and the confirmation check is already deliberately ink.
verdicts.amendment: (a) Make the confirmation claim store-level truth only — e.g. 'Saved to Keychain — checking with GitHub…' — or cut the interstitial and morph straight to the claim-free loading pill on store success; 'Connected' may never render before GitHub's first answer. (b) Either keep Connect inert until the shape gate passes (so green genuinely marks the unlock) or render the shape-pass check in ink.

verdicts.reason: Survived an adversarial pass on every axis. Motion: every check binds to a real callback (submitToken return, startLiveSession, first-poll rows callback, onAuthFailure — all verified to exist in AppDelegate.swift except the honestly-declared first-success seam); 'verifying…' is deliberately static (no spinner = no ambient motion); re-submit reset is explicitly animation-free. State honesty: 'connected' requires GitHub's actual answer — the only variant whose positive claim structurally cannot outrun the truth; runtime-401 pre-checked rows 1–2 are true facts; wrongShape leaves rows 2–3 pending (progress never fabricated); Keychain-write failure fails row 2. Color: checks are INK, danger only on the failed row (a genuine intervene), focus accent is chrome. Gray-swap: pending/done/failed disambiguate by SHAPE (circle / check / per-reason glyph). The error family collapses into the failing row — the brief's 'same family' made literal. Code claims verified: store is synchronous, redacted() renders 'ghp_•(40)', onAuthFailure is wired at AppDelegate.swift:154-156. Note for the session (not a violation): specify the first-poll NETWORK-failure state so row 3 doesn't sit on 'verifying…' unbounded — that belongs to the sanctioned caution/degraded-reading treatment, never a spinner; and keep the 0/150ms row-1/row-2 stagger bound to real event order only.

One hit: the pass path reads 'holds 600ms, calls submitToken, then the island morphs' — the morph is unconditional on the call, not on its Result. A Keychain-write failure (.keychainWrite, a real outcome submitToken returns) would morph to the loading pill anyway: fabricated progress on a failed store. Variants 1 and 4 both say 'on store success'; this spec omits it. Everything else is genuinely clean and it is the purest burden position: zero panel changes (canBecomeKey stays false — no focus-non-theft proof owed at all), the clipboard read maps 1:1 to a deliberate click, the secret never renders (redacted-only is stronger than a masked field), the ink check next to the redacted shape claims only what the shape gate backs, danger is spent on genuine intervene lines with per-reason glyph shapes (incl. the dashed-circle clipboard-empty) so gray-swap holds, and mocking the macOS pasteboard alert so the human feels that OS-level risk is honest practice. The OS alert's focus grab is OS-mediated and user-click-initiated — same class as Chip A activating the browser — not HUD focus theft.
verdicts.amendment: Gate the morph on submitToken == .success; route .keychainWrite to the same error-line slot with its own glyph/copy, chip untouched and retryable. One clause in the spec.

verdicts.reason: One hit, a behavioral regression vs shipped code: today every auth failure force-shows the panel (HUDPanelController.swift:89-94 — 'a state the user must see NOW'; isVisible=true + immediate render). This variant recasts auth errors as a collapsed PILL STATE and never restates that rule — so a runtime 401 while the island is hidden (menu 'Hide island') becomes an invisible intervene signal: the radar silently dead, exactly the never-miss/trust break the moat forbids. Not a fabrication, but a softened state by omission.
